BELIEF_STATE: UNDERSTANDING: Module responsibility: Prevent bounded runs from completing until final verification gates pass. Key data flows: - INPUT: persisted RunRecord, required gates, optional project verification results. - PROCESSING: Collect failed gates, optionally run verifier, persist pass/fail metadata, block run on failures. - OUTPUT: PreCommitReport and updated run state. Critical invariants: - Failed gates block final completion. - Failure metadata is structured and stored on the run record. - Passing pre-commit keeps the run in progress so the action queue can perform final completion. IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY: Approach: Keep pre-commit verification as an explicit action before final CompleteStep. Complexity_areas: synchronous verification from runtime code, avoiding test fixture dependence on full project docs. Patterns_applied: explicit gate failure model, deterministic metadata keys, blocked outcome persistence.
